subject: Urgent: VerdantAI performance surge — RCA draft & actions
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie@verdantai.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: amit@verdantai.ai, support@verdantai.ai
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VerdantAI production: spikes in latency and increased 5xx rate

Hi Olga —

We saw a sustained spike starting ~08:45 PST across our inference endpoints: 95th percentile latency jumped from ~180ms to 1.9s and error rate increased to ~4.8% for ~40 minutes. This impacted our checkout flow (payments) for ~10k end-users.

We've collected traces and lightweight logs and attached an incident snapshot (verdantai_incident_snapshot_20261110.pdf). Can you confirm receipt and advise on immediate mitigation? Our customer success team is asking for an executive summary and next steps.

—Jamie
Senior Product Manager, Verdant AI
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@verdantai.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-10T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VerdantAI production: spikes in latency and increased 5xx rate

Jamie —

Thanks for the snapshot — we received it and have spun up a bridge. Karthik (SRE) is investigating; Marissa (CS) will coordinate customer communications and goodwill.

Immediate actions we have taken:
- Routed new traffic away from the affected GPU pool (regional failover) to limit exposure.
- Enabled aggressive KV cache warming for VerdantAI prefixes.
- Rolled back a recent batching heuristic change in the staging branch that surfaced in canary last night.

I'll share a preliminary timeline within 2 hours and follow with a formal RCA by EOD tomorrow. Apologies for the disruption — executive leadership has been notified if we need credits or escalation.

Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: support@redwood.ai_ops@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-10T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VerdantAI production: spikes in latency and increased 5xx rate (prelim findings)

On the bridge we correlated the spike with three concurrent events:
1) A model-variant fallback that triggered for long-tail prompts due to stale kernel selection metadata on a subset of nodes. Fallback caused larger-than-expected KV exchanges.
2) A batching policy change pushed to canary/staging yesterday that incorrectly widened batch size for request groups with heterogenous seq-len distribution. This amplified tail latency under Verdant's traffic shape.
3) A regional routing flapping incident (LB healthchecks) that introduced brief request duplication and temporary hot spots on the GPU pool.

Immediate mitigations completed: roll back batching heuristic (confirmed), force-refresh kernel metadata cluster-wide, and apply a targeted LB rate-limit to reduce duplicate requests. Error rate has dropped to ~0.6% and P95 trending down.

Next: I'm preparing a formal RCA doc and a remediation plan with owners. Tentative JIRA: INF-4821 (batching rollback), INF-4832 (kernel metadata hardening).

Karthik
SRE Lead — Redwood Inference
From: Amit Desai <amit@verdantai.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-11T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VerdantAI production: spikes in latency and increased 5xx rate

Appreciate the quick action. Two asks from our side:
1) Formal RCA and timeline for permanent mitigations — our execs want a one‑page summary by EOD tomorrow.
2) Proposal for customer impact credits for the 40-minute window and a short-term SLA protection while fixes land.

We can join a review call this afternoon.

—Amit
VP Engineering, Verdant AI
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Amit Desai <amit@verdantai.ai>, Jamie Park <jamie@verdantai.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, execs@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-11T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: VerdantAI — RCA draft & proposed remediation commitments (attached)

Amit / Jamie —

Attached is our RCA draft (verdantai_rca_draft_20261111.pdf) and a proposed remediation timeline (remediation_timeline_verdantai_20261112.csv). Executive summary (one paragraph):

- What happened: A combination of an unintended batching-policy widening and stale kernel-selection metadata led to degraded throughput and elevated 5xxs for long-tail prompts on a subset of nodes; regional LB healthcheck flapping exacerbated hotspots.
- Impact: ~40 minutes of degraded P95 and ~4.8% error rate affecting checkout flows for VerdantAI customers (~10k end-users).
- Immediate fix: rollback batching heuristic, cluster kernel metadata refresh, targeted LB rate-limits — validated in production; error rate reduced.

Proposed remediation & owners (high level):
- INF-4821: Pin batching policy + add unit/e2e tests — Owner: Karthik — target: 2026-11-18
- INF-4832: Kernel metadata reconciliation job + alerting — Owner: Karthik — target: 2026-11-15
- INF-4840: LB healthcheck stabilization and autoscaling guardrails — Owner: Networking Team — target: 2026-11-20
- CS remediation: goodwill credits proposal and customer-facing summary — Owner: Marissa — target: 2026-11-13

Ask: Please review the RCA draft and remediation timeline. If you sign off, we will: (1) create the JIRA backlog and (2) schedule a 30-minute exec readout with Verdant leadership tomorrow at 11:00 PST.

Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: amit@verdantai.ai, jamie@verdantai.ai
Date: 2026-11-12T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VerdantAI — RCA draft & proposed remediation commitments (confirmed commitments)

Thanks — I reviewed the draft and confirm the remediation plan. Additional technical notes:
- I'll add a short-term safety net that pins the batching window for Verdant's tenant until we ship tests (feature-flagged).
- We'll add an e2e perf test that simulates Verdant traffic shape to catch regressive batch heuristics.
- I'll coordinate with Networking on LB healthcheck tuning; INF-4840 created and assigned.

Marissa — please proceed with the CS credit proposal and final customer note. Olga — please schedule the exec readout; I will present the technical section and commit to weekly progress updates in INF-4821/INF-4832.

Karthik
SRE Lead — Redwood Inference
